description: Single-source ranged-split edge cases. A content length that divides evenly across the chunk count yields equal pieces; an uneven division rounds the piece size up so the early pieces are full-sized and the final piece absorbs the shorter remainder ending at the last byte; a tiny content length with a piece size larger than the remaining bytes still terminates cleanly at the final byte; and a single-byte single-chunk split yields one zero-to-zero piece. A zero or negative content length advertised with range support is still rejected with the neutral error category.
